channel.title: Health Tidbits
channel.description: A daily 4-5 minute podcast distilled from the Doctor Health Podcast Library: one doctor or health-expert conversation a day, turned into its most important tidbits. Hosted by Mimi and Alex.
channel.itunes:author: Naveen Chatlapalli

item.title: Ep 1: Sleep Like It Matters — Matthew Walker's Best Ideas
item.description: Mimi and Alex distill Matthew Walker's Diary Of A CEO sleep episode: caffeine's three hidden costs, why sleep debt can't be banked, NASA nap rules, sleep and weight loss, and the 2 a.m. playbook. Source transcript and analysis are in the doc-health-pod library.
